Accessible entrance facing the City Hall Common.
Bathrooms on 1st and 3rd floors.
Two elevators.

Accessibility Information
Police Headquarters Accessibility
Accessible entrance from Goldsberry Street (front entrance).
6 designated parking spaces; 1 designated for a handicap van.
2 accessible elevators from the main lobby.
2 accessible public restrooms in the main lobby; 1 male and 1 female.
Close

Worcester Senior Center
128 Providence Street
Worcester, MA 01604 -
Map
Phone: 508-799-1232, Fax: 508-799-1743,
Email Us
Hours: Monday - Friday 9 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
Accessible via WRTA Bus Line.
View Schedules and Routes
Accessibility Information
Senior Center Accessibility
2 accessible entrances; one at the front of the building and one next to the front desk that leads to the parking lot.
12 designated parking spaces; 5 in front and 7 in rear.
2 accessible elevators.
2 unisex single accessible public restrooms on the first floor, 1 unisex single accessible restroom on our second floor and all three floors have restrooms in which one of the stalls is fully accessible.
Close
